translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Runacuna lutancunata yarpar jusayog ricacuyashganpita Jesucristo yachasishgan
Saypitanami fariseucuna y Moisés guelgashgan leycunata yachasegcuna Jerusalenpita shayämorgan Jesusta tapuyänanpä. Chaycurnami Jesusta tapuyargan:
“¿Imanirtä discïpuluyquicuna unay runacunapa costumbrincunata mana cäsur micuyänanpä maquincunata maylacuyansu?”
Sayno niyaptin paycunatapis Jesús nergan: “Gamcunapis ¿imanirtä Tayta Diosninsipa palabranta cumpliyänayquipa trucanga say costumbrilayquicunata más cumpliyanqui?
Tayta Diosninsipa palabranchöga caynömi nican:

content.text: Pipis mamanta o taytanta maldicionag cäga wanusish casun.’

content: Mamayquitawan taytayquita ali ricayänayquipä niptinpis gamcunaga manami yanapaycäyanquisu. Saymi runacunata yachaycäsiyanqui: ‘Tayta Dioslapämi imaycäpis caycan’ nerga mamantawan taytanta manana yanapänanpä. Sayno yachasirmi gamcunaga Tayta Diosninsipa palabranta manacagman churaycäyanqui.
¡Ishcay cära runacuna! Gamcuna sayno cayänayquipä cashganta musyarmi Santu Espíritu profëta Isaiasta tantyasergan. Saymi pay cayno guelgargan:

content.text: ‘Cay runacunaga janan shongulami: “Tayta Dios, Tayta Dios” nicäyäman.
Saynöpis manami lapan shongunwansu nogata chasquicayäman.
Paycunaga wilacuynëta yachasiyänanpa trucanga runacunapa costumbrilantami yachaycäsiyan.

content: Nircurnami runacunata gayaycur Jesús nergan: “Cay nishgäcunata lapayqui shumag tantyacuyay.
Manami imatapis micushganpitasu pipis jusayog ricacun, sinöga lutancunata parlashganpitami.”
Saymi discïpuluncuna Jesusta niyargan: “Sayno niptiqui fariseo runacuna fiyupami rabiacuyash.”
Sayno wilayaptinmi Jesús nergan: “Paycuna ima nishgantapis ama chasquipäyaysu. Chacrapita mana ali jachacunata luquir jitarishgannömi paycunatapis Tayta Diosninsi juzgar naupanpita gargongapä.
Paycunaga yachag-tucurpis gapranömi caycäyan. Gapra mayinta gapra pushar ishcan pözuman jegayashgannömi paycunapis y yachasishgancunata chasquipagcunapis infiernuman gaycush cayangapä.”
Sayno niptinmi Pedro nergan: “Ima micuyta micurpis jusaynag cashganta y lutancunata rimar jusayog cashganta tantyaycasilämay, taytay.”
Saymi Jesús nergan: “¿Gamcunapis manacu tantyayanquirä?
Imata micushgansipis manami jusayogyäsimansisu, sinöga micurcushga päsacunlami.
Shonguncho lutancunata yarpachacurmi isanga pipis jusayog ricacun. Sayno carmi runa lutanta riman y lutanta ruranpis.
Runacunaga shonguncho lutancunata yarpachacurmi runa mayinta wanusiyan, suwacuyan, lulacuyan y runa mayintapis ashliyan. Saynöpis adulteriucho cayan, runacuna chinëru cayan y warmicunapis waynäcuyan.
Saycunata rurarmi runacuna jusayog ricacuyan. Sayno captenga manami micuycunata micursu o maquinsita mana awicuylapa micursu jusayog ricacunsi.”
Mana Israel warmi Jesucristuman yäracushgan
Saypitanami Jesús aywargan Tiro y Sidón provinciacunaman.
Say marcacunachömi Cananea
runacuna täyargan. Saymi juc Cananea warmi Jesús cagman aywaycur ruwacorgan: “¡Rey Davidpa castan Jesús, cuyapaycalämay! ¡Warmi wawätami supay löcayäsish!” nir.
Sayno niptin Jesús manami imatapis parlacorgansu. Saymi discïpuluncuna Jesusta niyargan: “Segaypa gaparashpan tagay warmega umansitapis nanäsinnachä. Jucla aywacunanpä niyculay, taytay.”
Sayno niyaptinmi say warmita Jesús nergan: “Tayta Diosninsi cachamash Israel runacunalata yanapänäpämi. Paycunaga ogracash uyshanömi caycäyan.”
Sayno niptinmi say warmi Jesuspa puntanman gongurpacuycur nergan: “¡Ama fiyu caysu! ¡Yanapaycalämay ari, taytay!”
Sayno ruwacuptinmi Jesús nergan: “Israel mayëcunatarämi yanapäshä. Gamcunata yanapaptëga canman wamracunapa tantanta guechurir algucunata jitapaycognömi.”
Sayno niptin warmi nergan: “Au, taytay. Sayno captinpis ämun pusupacushgantami alguncunapis micuyan.”
Saymi Jesús nergan say warmita: “¡Lapan shonguyquiwan sayno yäracamashgayqui alimi caycan! Sayno yäracamashgayquipitami wawayqui cachacashgana caycan.” Say hörami say warmipa wawan cachacargan.
Gueshyagcunata Jesucristo aliyäsishgan
Saypita aywacurnami Jesús chargan Galilea gocha cuchunman. Nircurnami juc jircanninman wisarcur saycho jamacorgan.

Saymi Jesús cagman asca runacuna shuntacäyargan. Sayno shuntacarmi apayargan puriyta mana puëdeg wegrucunata, gapracunata, macllucunata, parlayta mana puëdegcunata y waquin gueshyawan gueshyagcunatapis. Paycunatami Jesús lapanta aliyäsergan.

Sayno aliyäsishganta ricaycurmi runacuna fiyupa cushicuyashpan niyargan: “Cananga upacuna parlayannami, macllucunapis aliyaycäyannami, puriyta mana puëdeg wegrucunapis puriyannami y gapracunapis ricayannami.” Sayno nirmi Israel runacuna adorayashgan Tayta Diosta paycunapis alabayargan.
Chuscu waranga runacuna micuyänanpä milagruta Jesucristo rurashgan

Saypitanami discïpuluncunata gayaycur Jesús nergan: “Cuyapämi caycho nogansiwan caycag runacunata. Paycuna quimsa junagnami nogansiwan caycho caycäyan micuyta mana yawaylapa. Micönila wayincunapa cuticuyänanpä niptëga aywaycäyaptilannami vëtapis sarenga imanga.”
Sayno niptinmi discïpuluncuna niyargan: “¿Sunyag jircacho caycarga maychörä tariycushwan micuyta caysica runacuna micuyänanpäga, taytay?”
Sayno niyaptinmi paycunata Jesús taporgan: “¿Aycalatä tantayqui caycan?” “Ganchis tantawan juc ishcay pescädulami caycan, taytay” niyargan.
Sayno niyaptinmi lapan runacunata nergan jamacuyänanpä.
Jamaycuyaptinnami pescädutawan ganchis tantata aptarcur Tayta Diosta Jesús manacur agradëcicorgan. Nircurnami paquircur paquircur discïpuluncunata macyargan paycuna aypucuyänanpä.
Saymi lapan micuyargan pacha junta. Pusushgancunatanami shuntayargan ganchis canasta juntata.
Saycho micogcunaga cayargan warmicunata wamracunatapis mana yupaylapa chuscu waranganömi (4,000).
Saypitanami büquiman wisarcur discïpuluncunawan Jesús aywacuyargan Magdala partiman.

footnotes.text: Cananea runacunaga mana Israel runacunami cargan.
